paragraphs.text: Amjad was the tyrant who ruled by the eponymous land of Amjad . His name is revered by those who serve him. The cruel king is known to bring his servants into the Heart of Shanodin , in order to know the real nature of those whom he chooses to keep at his side. His name was often followed by honorifics including "may his name provoke trembling", "may his name cause jaundice", "may his name be feared", "may his name cause nosebleeds", "may his name cause head lice", "may his name be cause for drinking", and "may his name cause silence".
